headline: Actor Emily Hampshire says the chaotic AI character she plays in Marvel's 'VisionQuest' comes from imagining Tony Stark's ego stuffed into a pair of sunglasses.
score_reason: Pop-culture item about a fictional AI; pool score kept.
importance_line: It matters only to fans of the Marvel series, with no real-world AI development involved.
summary: Comic Basics reports that Emily Hampshire, who plays the AI persona E.D.I.T.H. in Marvel's new Disney+ series 'VisionQuest', told New York Comic Con she pictures the character as Tony Stark's ego bottled in sunglasses, armed with weapons and handed to a teenager, as in 2019's 'Spider-Man: Far From Home'. The series premiered on 14 Oct 2026 with two of its eight episodes.
notes: Fictional AI; Comic Con date not stated.
